package rulefixtures

import (
	"sync"
)

// scenario for sync_mutex_for_atomic_counter: `mu.Lock(); count++; mu.Unlock()` for simple integer counters
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: warning.

type RequestCounter struct {
	mu    sync.Mutex
	count int64
}

func (rc *RequestCounter) Increment() {
	rc.mu.Lock()
	rc.count++
	rc.mu.Unlock()
}

func (rc *RequestCounter) Value() int64 {
	rc.mu.Lock()
	val := rc.count
	rc.mu.Unlock()
	return val
}
